title: Create sales shipments from authorized sales order source selection
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Provide bounded authorized approved-sales-order candidates and exact eligible detail projection using enabled stock-out and sales-order menus and current customer scope before counts/pagination. Show exact id/no/customer, product/spec/base unit and remaining shippable quantity under ERP343 semantics. Duplicate ambiguous source product rows and missing units are explicitly unavailable; foreign/deleted/cancelled/unapproved sources excluded. Do not expose unrelated order fields or treat draft reservations as posted shipment.

Wire stock-out create/edit source selector to explicitly persist SalesOrderId, authoritative customer and eligible products; retain selected legitimate warehouse, positive partial shipment and exact unit semantics. Reopen retains explicit source; historical null sources remain visibly unlinked. Do not silently restore shipment capacity from returns or bypass ERP343 quantity, ERP359 return and ERP367 loading cancellation guards. Revalidate authoritative source and cumulative quantities under existing source lock at approval so stale candidates or simultaneous shipments cannot over-ship. Failed/denied edit leaves original document/stock/ledger intact and form values retained; prevent duplicate clicks. Real SQL own/foreign/partial/duplicate/unknown unit/revoked/source cancellation/concurrent approval and executable JS workflow tests plus real browser evidence or precise blocker.

Shipment creation cannot establish explicit order trace through the normal screen.
